subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue this A2UI-to-dashboard bridge only after the browser Canvas action-ingress contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 is approved, or should the dashboard bridge define its own action path?
rationale: The request spans product direction and a security boundary because it would let sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI content ask a trusted parent/Gateway path to act.

options.title: Sequence through Canvas ingress first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard bridge to reuse the approved browser Canvas action endpoint once that contract exists.

options.title: Design a dashboard-owned bridge now
options.body: Let the dashboard plugin define its own action bridge, accepting the risk of a second web A2UI action contract that must later converge with Canvas.

options.title: Decline bundled bridge
options.body: Route A2UI/dashboard experiments to external plugins until maintainers approve a bundled dashboard direction and missing plugin APIs are identified.

recommendation.title: Sequence through Canvas ingress first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the dashboard bridge to reuse the approved browser Canvas action endpoint once that contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest visible owner signal for the current plugin-tab seam and whether this remains a bundled dashboard capability.
